title: Realistic First Person & Better Camera

A better verison of 'Better First Person and Smooth Camera Movement' (Nah, I just made it myself)

This Script can work with mobile, but those control doesn't support mobile. So expect bugs & glitches.

BasicCameraOffset is a customizable first/third-person camera system featuring FOV control, camera smoothness, mouse sensitivity, camera bob, movement tilt, camera shake, shoulder camera, realism effects, custom controls, and an in-game configuration terminal.
